meta.description: Your areas on Friends of Animals, one for each kind of role you hold.

dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.lead: One account for every role you hold. Pick the area you want to work in.

member.body: Your competition entries, certificates and donations will show here as those parts of the site open.
member.children: Your children, as a parent or guardian

admin.body: Tools for Friends of Animals staff. Each one checks that your role allows it.

organisation.body: Your organisation's own page comes later. Your role there is already set.
